en: Edit this poster precisely. Preserve all headline, illustration, text, numbers and footer. In the lower chart area, remove ALL horizontal colored and grey bars, because their lengths are inaccurate. Replace that area with three typographic statistical rows, each with equal visual weight and a thin horizontal separator (separators all same length, no quantitative geometry): "Low" then "2/36" then "5.6%"; "Medium" then "1/49" then "2.0%"; "High" then "14/57" then "24.6%". Align the three columns. Highlight High text in red, Low and Medium text black. This is a numerical table, no bar chart, no graphics representing quantities. Change only this chart area. Maintain square format and everything else.
zh: 精确编辑这张中文学术宣传图，保持整体布局、标题、14/17、正文、配色、插画和所有脚注不变。只做两处修正：1. 删除底部统计图中的全部彩色条和灰色背景条，改成清晰的三列表格，三行依次为「低」「2/36」「5.6%」；「中」「1/49」「2.0%」；「高」「14/57」「24.6%」。每列对齐，三行同等大小，高这一行文字用红色，行间细分隔线等长。无条形图，无表示数量的图形。2. 右上人物剪影上的四个纸条文字依次改为「交互关系」「行动规则」「惩罚机制」「受益结构」，避免误解为涌现无需设计。只修改以上两处，准确使用简体中文，保持正方形。
